method.description: Actually visually inspected four chronological sheets using view_image, every fourth frame plus last, against individually viewed exact-hash approved source. FFmpeg decoding limited to two CPU threads; no GPU submission or painting processor. Live Comfy history verified successful generation.

observations: Cow gently swishes its single tail, blinks, opens its smiling mouth and moves its head slightly; attached bell sways visibly. This provides meaningful bounded motion.
Four legs and hooves, two horns, two ears and one connected tail remain consistent across samples, with no observed malformed or duplicated anatomy.
Cream/brown coat patches, pink muzzle and inner ears, teal collar and yellow bell retain the approved source appearance. Bell and clapper remain present without acquiring a face.

Tail approaches the right margin during its widest swing but remains fully visible in sampled frames. Horns, ears, hooves and full body remain uncropped; no disappearing accessories or unintended morphing observed.
limitations: Sampled visual inspection is not realtime playback or inspection of every frame. Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of inter-sample artifacts or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
